page.layout: Two columns of parallel Hebrew grammar entries, left column then right column, each line a list entry; no headings, no margin notes; catchword "quod" at the bottom right of the right column.

main_text.l: וַיָּסָב et circuivit, pro וַיָּסֹב fut. Kal, conv, Rad. סָבַב.
וַיָּסֶךְ et unxit se, pro וַיָּסֶךְ fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. סוּךְ.
וַיָּסֶךְ et obtexit, pro וַיָּסֶךְ fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. סָכַךְ.
וַיָּסַע et transstulit, pro וַיָּסַע fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. נָסַע.
וַיָּסַר et recessit, pro וַיָּסוֹר fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Vau conv. Rad. סוּר.
וַיָּסֵר et removit, pro וַיָּסִר vel וַיָּסַר, fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. סוּר.
וַיִּסַּת et incitavit, pro וַיִּסִּית, fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. סוּת.
וַיָּעֵר et contestatus est, pro וַיָּעִיד, fut. Hiph. conv. Rad. עוּד.
וַיַּעַט, & וַיָּעַט & involavit, pro וַיָּעֵט, fut. Hiph.
וַיַּעַט & amicivit se, pro וַיַּעֲטֶה, fut. Kal, conv. Rad. עָטָה.
וַיַּעַל & ascendit, vel ascendere fecit, pro וַיַּעֲלֶה, fut. Kal, vel Hiph. 3. f. m. Vau conv. Rad. עָלָה.
וַיַּעַן & respondit, pro וַיַּעֲנֶה, fut. Kal, conv. Rad. עָנָה.
וַיָּעֹף, & וַיָּעֹף & volavit, pro וַיָּעֹף, fut. Kal, conv. Rad. עוּף.
וַיָּעַף & fessus erat, Jud. 4. 21. pro וַיֵּעָיֵף, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Vau conv. Rad. עָיֵף.
וַיָּעַר & excitavit, pro וַיָּעִיר, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. conv. Rad. עוּר.
וַיַּעַשׂ & fecit, apoc. pro וַיַּעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, conv. Rad. עָשָׂה.
וַיַּעַשׂ, pro וַיַּעַט & involavit, & hoc pro יַעַט, quod

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are read from a small scan and may be imperfect; the consonantal forms are the most reliable part. Top of page: a Hebrew marker ("׳ ו") stands near the centre of the head, probably a printed catchword or signature of the gathering, not a running head, so it is left out. Line 1 of the right column begins "conv. Rad." and is a continuation of the left column's last entry, so it is kept as printed. The last left-column line and the catchword "quod" are printed as shown.
